faustformeln.titel: Light path within the pulse duration
faustformeln.hinweis: 100 fs correspond to 30 µm, 1 ps to 0.3 mm.
10 µJ at 100 kHz is 1000 mW = 1 W.

faustformeln.titel: Fluence from pulse energy and beam radius
faustformeln.hinweis: In short: F₀ = 2E_p/(πw₀²); with E_p in µJ and w₀ in µm this gives F₀ ≈ 63.7 · E_p / w₀² in J/cm².
The optical period is then about 3.4 fs.

normen.titel: Optics and photonics – Lasers and laser-related equipment – Vocabulary and symbols
normen.wozu: Uniform definitions and symbols for laser beam quantities. First port of call when a term is used differently in papers and data sheets.

normen.titel: Lasers and laser-related equipment – Test methods for laser beam widths, divergence angles and beam propagation ratios – Part 1: Stigmatic and simple astigmatic beams
normen.wozu: Defines the beam radius via **second moments** and the measurement method for $M^2$. This makes $w_0$, $z_\mathrm{R}$ and $\theta$ comparably measurable.

normen.titel: Lasers and laser-related equipment – Test methods for laser beam widths, divergence angles and beam propagation ratios – Part 2: General astigmatic beams
normen.wozu: Extends part 1 to beams with general astigmatism (e.g. twisted beam axes).

normen.titel: Lasers and laser-related equipment – Test methods for laser beam widths, divergence angles and beam propagation ratios – Part 3: Intrinsic and geometrical laser beam classification, propagation and details of test methods
normen.wozu: Background on beam classification and propagation; complements the measurement methods of parts 1 and 2.

normen.titel: Optics and photonics – Lasers and laser-related equipment – Test methods for laser beam power (energy) density distribution
normen.wozu: Measurement of the power or energy density distribution over the beam cross-section, i.e. the fluence profiles that matter for threshold experiments.

normen.titel: Optics and photonics – Lasers and laser-related equipment – Test methods for laser beam power, energy and temporal characteristics
normen.wozu: Measurement of average power, pulse energy, pulse duration and their stability, i.e. the quantities from chapter K01.

normen.titel: Lasers and laser-related equipment – Test methods for laser-induced damage threshold (parts 1 to 4)
normen.wozu: Framework for damage and ablation thresholds: terms, determination of the threshold (e.g. 1-on-1 and S-on-1), power handling and damage detection. Important if threshold fluences are to be reported comparably.

normen.titel: Geometrical product specifications (GPS) – Surface texture: Profile – Part 2: Terms and parameters, Part 3: Specification operators
normen.wozu: Roughness parameters in the profile section (e.g. $Ra$, $Rz$) and filters. Replaces the former standards ISO 4287 and ISO 4288.

normen.titel: Geometrical product specifications (GPS) – Surface texture: Areal – Part 2: Terms, definitions and surface texture parameters
normen.wozu: Areal parameters such as $Sa$ and $Sz$ for ablation surfaces and structures when profile sections are not enough.

normen.titel: Safety of laser products – Part 1: Equipment classification and requirements
normen.wozu: Laser classes (1, 1M, 2, 2M, 3R, 3B, 4) and requirements for manufacturers. Enclosed systems are often classified as class 1; the open beam path in the lab usually falls into class 4 (check the type plate or the risk assessment).

normen.titel: German ordinance on artificial optical radiation and technical rules
normen.wozu: Duties of the employer when operating lasers in Germany: risk assessment, laser safety officer, protective measures.
